title: Spanish Paella with Renkon and Lotus Root
description: A traditional Spanish paella dish with the added twist of renkon and lotus root, creating a unique and flavorful experience.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced renkon and lotus root, cooking until they start to brown.
Add the smoked paprika and saffron, stirring to combine.
Add the uncooked paella rice, stirring to coat the rice in the spice mixture.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot.
